tools.name: search_studios
tools.description: Find bookable craftsperson studios on CraftMe near a location or in a city, nearest first. Optionally only studios with a matching service.

tools.name: get_studio
tools.description: Name, address, rating and the bookable services (id, duration, price) of one studio. Nail and hair studios also list their upcoming courses.

tools.name: find_free_slots
tools.description: Free start times for one service, in the studio's time zone. Days from tomorrow up to 90 days ahead, at most 14 days per call. A time with a promotion field has a discount of the studio (percent, discounted price); it applies automatically when booked.

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Checks that the time is still free and returns a confirm_url. Nothing is booked yet: the user opens the link, signs in and confirms (deposit and terms of the studio apply there).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_studio" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Name, address, rating and the bookable services (id, duration, price) of one studio." → after: "Name, address, rating and the bookable services (id, duration, price) of one studio. Nail and hair studios also list their upcoming courses."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
